_comment: A thrown bomb's detonation: instant fire damage of 18 HP plus 2 per level, plus a dot of 5 HP plus 0.6 per level over 3 ticks at 30-tick intervals, both within a growing 2.0-unit radius. Deliberately mirrors nova-burst.json's numbers so the bomb reads as a thrown version of that skill; keep them in sync.
name: BombBurst
